title: heavy.command@1
description: A command heavy enough to share the machine through one lease (#1015): a full build or test suite an agent runs. DeepBuild ships entries for the common build and test runners; a repo adds its own in done.yaml's heavy_commands, and a plug-in can add more. A shell call is matched against them only by its argument prefix, in deep-hook, without waiting on the hub, and runs under `deep lease` with the entry's kinds. An entry can never match a command by anything but its argument prefix, make deep-hook wait on the hub, or stop a process.

name.description: The entry's name, such as cargo test.

argv_prefix.description: The program and the words a matched command starts with; every word after them must be an option, or the run is focused and matches no entry unless one names it.

kinds.description: The lease kinds it holds beside its cpu.slot, such as browser, gpu or stack; gpu:shared or gpu:exclusive names the GPU lease's mode.

jobs.description: How many jobs it runs at once: jobserver (it takes them from a jobserver), a fixed number n, or none of its own.
